synthesis: Offline FFmpeg libflite; computer-generated voice, not the entrant's voice
scenes: Action Receipt turns one notice into actions you can check. This walkthrough shows real program outputs, not a recording of the browser interface.
This invented school notice separates registration from payment. It also includes a consent form, a conditional transport request, and a fee that is explicitly waived.
The local rules propose three actions and flag two passages. Nothing is approved automatically. At this point, neither download includes any tasks or events.
Registration and the bus deposit keep their own deadlines and exact source quotations. The words are traceable, but a person must still check their interpretation.
The rules missed the consent instruction. The repair function uses the flagged passage to create a separate action. Its date stays unresolved and its approval stays unchecked.
The waived membership fee is marked as not an obligation. That decision preserves its reason without creating another task or calendar event.
Accessible transport applies only if needed. The phrase next Friday stays unresolved. The program does not invent a calendar date or remove the condition.
These review choices are scripted checks. Approving four actions produces four checklist tasks, but zero calendar entries. Confirming the two complete dates then enables two calendar entries.
This excerpt comes from the actual checklist file. Each approved action keeps its source quotation. The consent form and conditional email remain checklist tasks without calendar dates.
The calendar file contains only two entries. Registration is an all day marker. The deposit cutoff converts from five P M, U T C minus ten, to the same instant in U T C.
Editing the reviewed cutoff clears approval and date confirmation. Opening a saved review also requires fresh checks. Earlier decisions never silently authorize a new download.
Codex used the Devpost Learn Skill Pack, with generated planning documents in the public repository. The finished app runs local rules, without model downloads, accounts, or A P I credits.

Source and the offline browser app are on GitHub under nolankido, action receipt. This supporting walkthrough is complete. Actual browser footage and a public video link are still needed for the submission demo.
